description: Master registry for MediaLoom: two roles (builder + domain), each carrying its own 3-track KG (skills + knowledge + behaviors). The dashboard connects role roots into a single coherent graph.

roles.name: Builder (MediaLoom Engine)
roles.description: Knows how to acquire, probe, chunk, transcribe, and distill multimedia. Stable; evolves when ingestion techniques, models, or protocols upgrade.

graphs.description: Engine architecture, dual-path ASR strategy, audio chunking heuristics, and chapter scaffolding.
Executable engine skills: probe-media-stream, audio-chunking-compression, whisper-asr-transcription, chapter-alignment-anchoring.
Engine behaviors: audio-budget-constraint (24MB limit, format 140 preference), timestamp-anchoring-rule.

roles.name: Domain (Harvested Knowledge)
roles.description: What the agent learns from ingested videos and media sources. Grows dynamically via propose-review.

graphs.description: Concepts, theories, causal models, and historical parallels extracted from multimedia.
Domain-side reusable skills (candidate and accepted SOPs distilled from tutorial videos).
Domain-specific policies and constraints learned from digested content.
